discoveries: clamp_pos_of_pos: by_cases h1: val < -limit; if so, omega; else by_cases h2: val > limit; if so exact hl; else exact hv
clamp_neg_of_neg: by_cases h1: val < -limit; if so, omega (-limit < 0); else by_cases h2: val > limit; omega (val<0); else exact hv
pidOutputRaw_pos: Int.mul_pos hgP herr + omega (treats products as atoms)
linarith is MATHLIB ONLY — use omega after naming products
split_ifs is MATHLIB ONLY — use by_cases + simp only [if_pos/if_neg]
expo_as_correction: (1-ec)*cv + ec*cv^3 = cv + ec*(cv^3-cv)
cv_cube_le_cv: cv^3 <= cv for cv in [0,1]
Rat.add_neg_cancel : a + -a = 0
import must come BEFORE module docblock in Lean 4
INT16_MIN/MAX: use simp only [INT16_MIN, INT16_MAX] at * before omega
abbrev is transparent to omega; simp-unfold first is safer
prefix is reserved in Lean 4 — use pfx/sfx
CRC-32 is LSBIT-first (reflected): use >>> right-shift
CRC-64-WE is MSBIT-first: use <<< left-shift, check bit 63
FVSquad.lean AND Basic.lean must both import new files
Int.add_emod_right : (a + b) % b = a % b
wrap_bin bug: bin + n < 0 iff bin <= -n-1
by_contra unavailable without Mathlib 4.29; use by_cases + omega
simp only [if_pos h1, if_neg h2] for case-splitting on if-then-else
For radians/degrees proof: parameterise by p : Rat; round-trip by field_simp; ring
computeT3 proof: simp [max_def] + linarith covers all cases
AlphaFilter induction: use induction n generalizing state for state-updating recursion
ring, nlinarith, linarith are MATHLIB ONLY — not available in standard Lean 4 stdlib
simp only [def_name] beta-reduces let-bindings in goals
Rat.zero_div NOT available — use simp [Rat.div_def, Rat.mul_comm]
Transitivity lt_le: by_cases + by_contradiction pattern
cube_mono_rat: case split on sign of v2, then v1
constrain_mono via simp only + by_cases on branches
expo_mono_val: needs constrain_mono + cube_mono_rat + two Rat.add_le_add steps
pidStateIterate: prove one_step lemma then use in induction
updateIntegral convergence: Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hg he) hdt
clamp saturation: rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)] then exact Int.le_refl _
rConstrain v 0 0 = 0: by_cases h1 : v < 0; by_cases h2 : v > 0; else Rat.le_antisymm
Rat.add_nonpos NOT available: use calc
Rat.div_nonneg NOT available: use rw [Rat.div_def]; Rat.mul_nonneg + Rat.inv_pos
simp only [if_neg h, if_pos h2] + rfl to close the positive case of rConstrain case split
